name: Sau Shooter
subtitle: Sour Shield Breaker
mechanism: Turret (LotusShooter targeting). Spits sour sau fruit; a fruit that hits an enemy still holding a shield (StreetVendorZombie baskets, shield_points() > 0) deals shield_mult x damage (data/projectiles/sau_fruit.json), so two fruits break the 120 HP baskets.

abilities.name: Sour Spit
abilities.trigger: Enemy inside 14 m forward cone, aimed within 5 deg
abilities.effect: Fires a sau_fruit (20 damage, x3 against a shield).

clipAnnotations.idle: Fruit head bobs on its leaf collar.
clipAnnotations.attack: Inhale squash, lunge (fruit leaves at 0.24 s), settle.
clipAnnotations.die: Squash and shrink into the lawn.
